subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2655
title: Requires the Housing and Community Services Department to develop a housing stipend pilot program to provide housing stipends to individuals to move to a city where their labor is expected to benefit economic development of the city.
headline: HB 2655 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2655 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2655 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
